response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile engineer with a strong software craftsmanship background, but his recent and predominant experience is in TypeScript/Node.js full-stack and web development, not Java/Kotlin/JVM. Java appears only tangentially in older roles (robotic arms, IDE C/C++ work), with no evidence of Spring, Kotlin, or IDE internals/language tooling experience specific to the JVM ecosystem required for this role.
strengths: Long track record (15+ years) across diverse technical domains and complex systems
Demonstrated experience with developer tooling (test runners, assertion libraries, CI setup) showing genuine interest in tooling
Strong communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source project leadership
concerns: No demonstrated recent or deep experience with Java, Kotlin, or the Spring ecosystem
No evidence of IDE internals, JVM tooling, or application server integration work
Current and recent roles are focused on TypeScript/Node.js, not JVM enterprise development

key_factors.factor: No IDE internals or JVM tooling experience
Strong general software craftsmanship and tooling interest
